note: Read 2026-10-31. The State's legal portal (leganet.cd) gave no answer; the texts were read in the copies Droit congolais (droitcongolais.info, a private compilation of the Journal officiel's texts) publishes, marked secondary. Majority: Code de la famille (Loi n° 87-010 du 1er août 1987) as amended by Loi n° 16/008 du 15 juillet 2016, art. 219: a minor is a person of either sex not yet eighteen full years; the 2016 text of the emancipation article reads 'dès que l'enfant a dix-huit ans accomplis', where the 1987 text added 'ou même plus tôt quand il contracte le mariage' (marriage under eighteen is no longer allowed; not held). Work: null. Code du travail (Loi n° 015/2002 du 16 octobre 2002), art. 6: capacity to contract work is sixteen; at fifteen only with the express derogation of the labour inspector and the parental authority, and only for light work by ministerial order (not held). The minimum age is thus sixteen, but what the law says of a younger performer wasn't found: the Code has no performer rule in the text read, the Loi n° 09/001 du 10 janvier 2009 portant protection de l'enfant was saved as a scanned PDF with no text layer and wasn't read, and the 2016 amendments to the Code du travail answered with an empty file. The form needs both, so work is null. Service: null; no law on military service or recruitment (the 2011 law on the armed forces, the 1997 decree on the Service national) was read.

sources.title: Loi n° 16/008 du 15 juillet 2016 modifiant et complétant la Loi n° 87-010 du 1er août 1987 portant Code de la famille (Droit congolais)
sources.said: Le mineur est l'individu de l'un ou de l'autre sexe qui n'a pas encore l'âge de dix-huit ans accomplis.

sources.title: Loi n° 015/2002 du 16 octobre 2002 portant Code du travail (Droit congolais)
sources.said: capacité de contracter est fixée à seize ... que moyennant dérogation expresse
